'''Star Trek 50: First Edition''' is the 28th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on September 30, 2016. The set consists of 18 cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*4 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Neutral)
*2 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*5 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*5 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]

==Rarity Breakdown==
*18 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
